about: cursorful.com scrolled end to end with embedded demo videos, then Pricing and Editor pressed in the fixed nav bar. Reported 2026-09-24: both presses missed, our hand drawn on the demos' cursors.
notes: The creator's pointer is a light Windows cursor, 18px arrow / 21-22px hand. It is visible 0-2.4s, then HIDDEN (keyboard scrolling) until 22.9s, when it appears as a hand on Pricing.
Pricing: hand at (950,42) from 22.9s, pressed ~23.2s, the page smooth-scrolls to the pricing section under the fixed bar.
Editor: hand at (1210,32) 29.41-29.54s; the capture then emits NO frame until 30.27s, the press is inside that gap, and the next frame is the editor page loading with no pointer drawn.
Every pointer-shaped thing on screen from 2.4s to 22.9s belongs to somebody else: the cursor inside the embedded YouTube demo, the one inside the Shopify demo, and a Cursorful stylised arrow.

stranger_budget_s is a RATCHET, not a target. On 2026-09-24 after the fix it measured 3.07s, every second of it while the page stood still (the YouTube demo's cursor 3.8-7.0s, the Shopify one 14.0-14.5s before the page moved again). A cursor in a demo on a still page, with the creator's own hidden, cannot be told from theirs by pixels; it needs the vision pass's 'picture of a screen' regions. Before the fix: pointer located in 21% of frames, both presses lost. Lower this when it improves; never raise it.
